'''V2''' was an [[XQ5 Platform|XQ5 platform]] which, along with its sister platform [[V1]], was part of the initial research facility for the ''[[Vorknkx]]'' project. They were designed to defend the [[Vorknkx Project Base]].

==History==
These facilities were heavily damaged in an assault by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s rogue forces, and were forced to evacuate. [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] and his [[Missile Boat]] were among loyal [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces responsible for providing cover for the evacuation.
